title: P38100PW corn (Pioneer P38100PW): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P38100PW corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P38100PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. About 104 days to harvest, 7.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P38100PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P38100PW or P38100. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2025 as NSIC 2025 GMCn 98. Corteva Agriscience bred it. It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.82 tonnes per hectare in the trials (8.55 in Luzon, 7.08 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P38100PW or P38100, this is the same corn. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7.82 tonnes per hectare in the trials (8.55 in Luzon, 7.08 in Mindanao).
**Plant height:** about 200.6 cm.
**Recommended for:** Luzon and Mindanao.
**Type:** Yellow GM hybrid.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P38100PW corn takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.82 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 116 to 120 days after planting (Pioneer), 104 to 105 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.05 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 78.07 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 13 t/ha (Pioneer), NSIC trials 8.55 t/ha Luzon, 7.08 Mindanao.

**Traits in the seed:** PowerCore (MON 89034 x TC1507 x NK603): three Bt proteins (Cry1A.105, Cry2Ab2, Cry1F) against corn borer, earworm, fall armyworm and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance, 95:5 refuge seed blend.
**Season:** Wet and dry.
**Where:** All of Luzon and the Visayas.
Big ears and kernels.
Spacing 70 x 20 cm or 60 x 20 cm.
Shorter plant (about 195 to 206 cm in NSIC trials).
Shelling about 78 percent in NSIC trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on Pioneer's current Philippine list and BPI's Jan 2025 list. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant P38100PW corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P38100PW the same as P38100PW?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P38100PW is another name for P38100PW, registered as NSIC 2025 GMCn 98. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.82 tonnes per hectare in the trials (8.55 in Luzon, 7.08 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P38100PW?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
